items.stem: Total cost of ownership for a purchased part should include the unit price plus:

options.text: Freight, quality, inventory-holding and end-of-life costs
options.rationale: Correct: TCO adds all acquisition, use and disposal costs to the unit price.
List price alone is exactly what TCO is designed to go beyond.
General staff salary is not a part-level TCO element.
Income tax is not a procurement TCO component.

items.explanation: TCO adds freight, quality, holding and end-of-life costs to unit price.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A buyer's BATNA in a negotiation is:

options.text: The best alternative to a negotiated agreement
options.rationale: Correct: BATNA is the best option if no deal is reached, and it sets the walk-away point.

options.text: The budget authority the buyer holds
options.rationale: That is spend authority, not BATNA.
The supplier's margin is not the buyer's BATNA.
Payment terms are a deal term, not the alternative to a deal.

items.explanation: BATNA is the best alternative to a negotiated agreement.

items.stem: A critical part is single-sourced overseas. Select TWO actions that most reduce continuity-of-supply risk.

options.text: Qualify a second source in a different region
options.rationale: Correct: a qualified alternate source directly reduces single-source risk.

options.text: Hold a strategic safety stock of the critical part
options.rationale: Correct: buffer stock bridges a supply interruption while alternatives activate.

options.text: Switch the contract from fixed-price to cost-plus
options.rationale: Contract type changes cost risk, not supply continuity.

options.text: Extend standard payment terms to 90 days
options.rationale: Longer payment terms do not protect supply continuity.

options.text: Consolidate all spend with the single supplier for a discount
options.rationale: Consolidating increases dependence on the single source.

items.explanation: A qualified second source and strategic safety stock both reduce single-source continuity risk.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source
